name: Debt Payoff
description: Plan how to get out of debt: compare the snowball and avalanche methods and see your debt-free date.
prompt: A debt payoff planner where I list debts with balance, interest and minimum payment, add an extra monthly amount, and it compares the snowball and avalanche methods with the debt-free date, interest paid and payoff order.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: Planifica cómo salir de deudas: compara los métodos bola de nieve y avalancha y mira cuándo quedarás libre de deudas.
